label: Legend
value: Built by King Uttarasena to enshrine his share of the Buddha's relics
quote: It was built by Uttarasena, an ancient king of Swat, to enshrine his share of the relics of Buddha.

label: Identified
value: Identified by Colonel Deane and S.A. Stein in the British period
quote: The Shingardar stupa was identified by Colonel Deane and S.A Stein during the British period.

label: Height
value: About 18 m high; the foundations go about 8 m deep
quote: The actual monument measures eighteen meters, and the foundations are eight meters deep.

label: Dating
value: Built in the sixth century CE, not in the time of the Buddha
quote: the stupa of king Uttarasena was not built in the late fifth century BCE after the Buddha's ascent to Nirvana, but in the sixth century CE.

label: Materials
value: Large stones and layers of thin slate
quote: The building of stupa is made of large stones and layers of thin slate.

label: Getting there
value: Just off the N-95 between Ghalegay and Barikot, beside the village
quote: The stupa is located in the village of Shingardar (a village between Ghalegay and Barikot).
